text: dsh-github 是面向 DSH Web 的 GitHub 与本地 Git 插件，在网页侧栏提供账号、仓库、本地 Git 和设置面板，并注册账号验证、仓库列表及 clone、pull、status、commit、push 工具。用户可配置 GitHub 账号和 API 地址，搜索可见仓库，克隆到本地、查看状态、拉取更新或提交变更；推送需在设置中启用。适合在 DSH 网页端管理 GitHub 与本地代码。需要 GitHub Token 和本机 Git，账号资料保存在本地配置文件。

dsh-github adds account, repository, local Git, and settings panels to DSH Web. Its Agent tools check accounts, list repositories, and run clone, pull, status, commit, or push. Push requires enabling its setting. A GitHub token and local Git are required; account data stays in a local config file.

I want to browse my GitHub repositories and clone one locally from DSH.
Can my assistant check a GitHub account and manage local Git changes?
dsh-github 的功能「GitHub 账号管理」：在侧栏账号页添加、编辑、验证或删除账号，并配置 Personal Access Token 与 API 地址；列表只展示脱敏账号摘要。
dsh-github 的功能「仓库浏览与搜索」：选择已配置账号后读取可见仓库列表，并按仓库名或描述筛选；可将选中的仓库带入 Clone 表单。
dsh-github 的功能「本地 Git 工作流」：通过面板或 Agent 工具对绝对路径仓库执行 clone、fast-forward pull、status、commit 和 push，并返回操作结果。
dsh-github feature “GitHub accounts”: Manage accounts in the sidebar and view masked summaries.
dsh-github feature “Repository browsing”: List visible repositories, filter them, and prepare a clone.
dsh-github feature “Local Git”: Run clone, fast-forward pull, status, commit, or push and view the result.
dsh-github 使用 GitHub API 验证账号并读取仓库信息，需要配置 Personal Access Token；Token 与插件设置保存在本机 ~/.dsh/dsh-github.json。
DSH 里有没有办法查看 GitHub 仓库并直接做本地提交？

dsh-github README · dsh-github：[中文文档](README.zh.md) | English

DSH Web UI 的 GitHub 与本地 Git 工作流插件。

dsh-github README · Features：- GitHub Personal Access Token account management with secret-free summaries.
- GitHub REST repository listing for github.com and GitHub Enterprise API URLs.
- Local Git operations: clone, fast-forward pull, status, commit, push, and force-with-lease.
- Sidebar panel with account, repository, local Git, and settings tabs.
- Push and force push are disabled by default and are guarded on the Host side.
- Token storage uses ~/.dsh/dsh-github.json with an atomic write and mode 0600.
- Git HTTP authentication uses an ephemeral http.extraheader environment configuration; tokens are not placed in clone URLs or process arguments.

dsh-github README · Install in a profile：Download the newest `dsh-github-*.tgz` from [Releases](https://github.com/andyfan1094/dsh-github/releases) and add it to the profile:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add D:\downloads\dsh-github-0.1.2.tgz
```

For local development, build and install from a checkout instead:

pnpm install
    pnpm run build
    dsh plugin --profile web add link:D:\项目\dsh-github

dsh-github README · Install in a profile：Restart the existing DSH Web process after installation. Open the GitHub sidebar entry and add a replacement token there. The plugin deliberately does not ship a token in source, package metadata, logs, or documentation.

dsh-github README · Agent tools：- github_auth_list, github_auth_test
- github_repo_list
- github_clone, github_pull, github_status
- github_commit, github_push

dsh-github README · Compatibility：- DSH Host `0.1.0-rc.8` or newer compatible release.
- Node.js `22.19.0` or newer.
- Git must be available through the configured executable.

dsh-github README · Security：The account file is local configuration, not a system secret vault. Use a fine-grained GitHub token with only the repositories and permissions needed by DSH. Revoke any token pasted into chat or source control and create a new one through the panel.
